stories.title: Define Enrollment Status Schema and Normalization Contract
stories.description: Define a normalized enrollment status schema (e.g., RECRUITING, ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING, COMPLETED, UNKNOWN) and mapping contract from raw ClinicalTrials.gov status values to standardized categories used by Evaluate Care.

stories.title: Implement Enrollment Status Extraction and Normalization Logic
stories.description: Extract raw enrollment status from ClinicalTrials.gov API responses and implement deterministic mapping logic to normalize statuses into defined categories, including handling edge cases such as missing or uncommon statuses.

stories.title: Expose Enrollment Status via Evaluate Care Facade
stories.description: Integrate normalized enrollment status into the clinical trials response schema and explicitly define API response contract fields (status, normalized_status, optional raw_status) exposed via evaluate_care_facade for downstream UI and tool consumption.

stories.title: Unit Tests for Enrollment Status Normalization
stories.description: Create unit tests validating correct mapping of all known ClinicalTrials.gov status values to normalized categories, including edge cases such as null, unexpected, or deprecated values.

stories.title: Integration Test for Enrollment Status End-to-End Flow
stories.description: Validate that enrollment status is correctly retrieved from ClinicalTrials.gov, normalized, passed through the service layer, and exposed via the Evaluate Care facade in clinical trial responses.
